start_frame_precedence: previous scene's last frame for that character (cross-scene chaining, the flow pattern)
chain_plan.within_scene: segments 2+ chain via chain_segments.py last-frame extraction (freedom lane, already wired)

description: Persistent character bank for scene-job v2. Pattern adapted (clean-room) from OpenX-Inc/flow src/flow/characters.py (MIT): CharacterRef{name, description, reference_image} + manifest.json, reference captured on first appearance and reused as generation conditioning. Extensions are ours: cutout + current_version (current-version law), lora, scope (human dialogue vs creature cries-only).

<character_id>.current_version: which version of that cutout is CURRENT for new work, and what it supersedes
<character_id>.cutout: path or repo path of the canon cutout the segments start from
<character_id>.description: canon visual description, copied from canon - never a donor production's character
<character_id>.lora: per-character LoRA id or null (none trained yet, 2026-10-28)
<character_id>.reference_image: bank-captured reference PNG (first-appearance frame) or null
